summary: Petition sought to bar Ben-Gvir from a publicly funded police-volunteer appreciation event; CEC chair Noam Sohlberg allowed attendance/speech after Ben-Gvir undertook not to campaign, while stressing that campaigning was prohibited and recommending legal review of the speech.
discovery_sources: Jerusalem Post 24 Aug 2026; Times of Israel 24 Aug 2026; Walla 24 Aug 2026; canonical Sheet dedupe search
resolution_notes: Preserve the Attorney General's position supporting exclusion and the ministry's defense that participation was natural given Ben-Gvir's responsibility for emergency squads. The operative petition was rejected subject to the no-campaign undertaking. No adverse illegality finding, motive inference or canonical accountability event is created; later full reasoning changing this disposition did not surface in the Sept. 6 freshness pass.
